thread:
izzy: FYI launching a 25m quiet window in ~8m for a header migration that touches api->router surface and console parsing. need pin coordination and rollback rules.

 tj: timeline and roll plan?

 izzy: start 1777772300. plan: 3% canary (7m) -> 30% (7m) -> 100%. runtime pinned to `runtime-v2.3-pin` during rollout. router will use `hdr-mig-2` shim variant. console feature flag `hdr_mig_ui` will stay OFF until 30% success.

 rai: important: console builds in prod sometimes auto-deploy. ensure console is pinned to previous artifact until flag flip, otherwise we risk mismatched expectation.

 izzy: good catch. I'll pin console artifact `console-2026-03-01` for the window.

 deploy-bot: Deploy queued for 1777772300. Steps: canary(3%) -> monitor(7m) -> expand(30%) -> monitor(7m) -> full. Auto-rollback thresholds attached.

 oncall: Rollback criteria (summary):
 - p95 latency increase > 180ms absolute vs baseline
 - 5xx rate increase > 0.5 percentage points absolute
 - gateway 502/504 jump > 0.25 percentage points
 - console header-parse warnings > 1% of requests
 If any trigger, abort and revert runtime+router to previous variants.

 tj: preflight commands: `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/runtime`, `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/router`, `curl -sS https://api.internal/health`. have scripts in /ops/playbooks/header-mig.md

 sam: i'll run the console harness during canary and post summary. ping me for quick rollback steps if needed.

 notes-bot: Draft release note: "runtime: header parsing improvement (v2.3); router: header shim for migration; console: UI behind feature flag hdr_mig_ui." Draft URL: https://go/release-notes/draft/1777772 (internal)

 deploy-bot: Canary started at 1777772300 -> 3% traffic. Monitoring hooks enabled.

 oncall: 1777772720: after 7m at 3% -> p95 +9ms, 5xx flat. no errors. promoting to 30%.

 sam: console harness shows 0.4% header-parse warnings in canary logs (below threshold). prepping staged flag flip at 30%.

 izzy: tagging @rai to flip `hdr_mig_ui` at 30% success. remember to unpin console artifact only after flag confirmed.

 rai: flipping to staged 50% then 100% once 30% monitor is green. will post results.

 oncall: 1777772600: 30% stage stable for 7m; metrics nominal. no rollback signals. proceeding to full rollout.

 deploy-bot: Gradewave to 100% started.

 izzy: final: API will accept v1 headers for a 10m soft-fallback after 100%, then we'll retire v1 if no issues. publishing final release note after completion.

 notes-bot: Release note pushed to internal doc: https://go/release-notes/1777772 (internal). remember to update public notes if customers ask.

 oncall: Final metrics look green at 100%. no anomalies. closing the window. great job. :tada:
